limitations: No competitor reruns or comparison to historical host timings.
Five process units per revision and strategy; aggregate medians and observed ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals.
The relative duration divides aggregate medians; it is not a median of within-block ratios.
Overlapping process ranges and byte-identical core prevent attributing small observed differences to an algorithmic improvement.
Full-wrapper, extraction and kernel intervals differ. Independently aggregated component medians need not sum to the full median.
Limen common fills are derived from native held segments; native cash/units/fill quantities/fees remain unobserved.
First API call, process launch to first valid output and post-full-call internal-core first call are distinct boundaries.
RSS is process-lifetime high-water, not incremental allocation or process-tree memory.
Native snapshot uses its original signal-timing contract, separately from the external prior-close-decision/next-close-fill contract.
Factorized pair: one fixed-order fresh/reuse pair per revision; fit counts and scientific parity are stronger evidence than its one-off duration ratio.
